text: GREEN ROOM SUPPLIES AND TIPS Basic supplies (as of 07/10/26) Appliances: •curling iron •Two flat irons •Brush hair drier •Airbrush instrument (foundation liquid in drawer) Soft Goods on counter and in tackle box: 	•Various application devices •Lens cleaner •Hairbrush cleaner •Hand sanitizer •Nine different sized makeup brushes •Green box for Kleenexes (must be filled with pop-up style facial tissues) •Selection of brushes and combs •Makeup setting spray •Heating style spray •Hairspray, unscented, 			•Bobbie pins •Static guard					•Bounce sheets (to cut hair static) •Makeup brush shampoo			•Green stick	 •clothing roller and refills •Light foundation •Basic face palette-medium •Universal face powder • Two tweezers •pencil sharpener Supplies Stored in Top Drawer of Filing Cabinet and on Top of Cabinet: 	•Face cleaner cloths (disposables) 	•Kleenex boxes •Make up case for an individual •Old airbrush and case •Iron •Cotton balls •Glass cleaner •Towels •Paper towels •Three clean capes and one white coat hanging on cabinet Additional Supplies in Drawer: •Additional hairbrushes •Additional makeup brushes •Airbrush foundation liquid, •Nail kit with nose hair clippers •Clothing pins, •Floss pics and floss •Hair ties •Personal Kleenex packet •Flower stickers •Bottled Water (under counter) Green Room Reminders •ALWAYS use make up applicators. •NEVER use fingers in makeup. •Sharpen pencils before each use. •Cleaning staff generally does not clean green room counter. It should be wiped down periodically. •Restock paper and facial cleaners two weeks before and just after March festival. •Restock water bottles as needed •Makeup capes should be washed before and after March and December festival and debates. •Light bulbs in lighting fixtures around the mirrors are color temperature specific to mimic lighting in studio. The bulbs should be replaced with similar bulb type. •If using airbrush system, shake foundation bottles for a minute before use. Make sure caps are 	closed tightly. Clean the airbrush appliance with water after each use and in between 	colors.
